name: Deftform
desc: Build powerful forms and automate your workflow with Deftform.

actions.name: get_workspace_details
actions.description: Retrieves all information about your Deftform workspace. Useful as a connection test.

actions.name: get_all_forms
actions.description: Lists all forms in your workspace, including their fields.

actions.name: get_form_fields
actions.description: Retrieves only the fields of a specific form. Great for understanding the structure before building automations.

actions.name: get_form_responses
actions.description: Retrieves all submissions (responses) for a specific form. Useful for reporting and data exports.

actions.name: get_submission_pdf
actions.description: Generates a PDF download link for a specific form submission by its unique response UUID.

actions.name: add_form_response
actions.description:
Submits a new response programmatically to a form. 
**Note:** This does **not** trigger email notifications to the form admin, unlike regular public submissions.

actions.name: update_form_settings
actions.description: Updates any combination of form settings via a single call — from title and status to integrations, SEO, and security.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_form_response
triggers.description: Triggers instantly when a new response is submitted to a Deftform form.
